extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and new Wattpad writers / creators (beginners)
extracted.subtask_description: Introductory guidance for new writers publishing fiction on the Wattpad platform, explaining why to create on Wattpad, how to connect with readers, and the key topic-areas/resources to learn for publishing and improving stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write the exact story you love to read
rubrics_metrics.description: Wattpad enables you to become a creator by encouraging you to write the exact story you love to read and helping you find an audience that will love it too.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes authenticity and writing what excites you as a core production criterion; Wattpad positions itself to help you find an audience and celebrate diverse voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find your audience, grow your readership, and connect
rubrics_metrics.description: Find your audience, grow your readership, and connect with your people on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishing on Wattpad is framed as not just posting text but locating and building an audience/community around your unique worldview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use comments and reactions to get reader feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments and reactions help push your story further. In-line story commenting provides you with real-time sentiment on your characters, plotline, and overall story direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can view comments on story parts to see what excites or hooks readers; reactions are sticker-based and give readers another way to share feelings. Use this feedback to inform revisions or future chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in Wattpad programs and opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Wattpad builds programs to support creativity and growth, and develops opportunities to help writers reach new heights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage platform programs (e.g., contests, studio opportunities, brand initiatives) as part of a strategy to grow readership and professional opportunities.
